user_approved_transfer: Keep current10-UAV/data/routes, transfer core algorithms and explicitly state adaptations.

ISCC_P2.preserved: Equal-client single-step aggregation Eq.(4), full digital FDMA Eq.(8), exact fixed-batch/position P2 Eq.(24) via bisection. Transmissions begin when each local compute finishes.
ISCC_P2.changed: Cached aerial video-text retrieval replaces radar human motion classification. q_s=1 because common cached data already collected; no artificial sensor failures. Same externally prescribed batch caps and200FL. Fixed nominal site head replaces ground server. Full32-bit20480-coordinate adapter upload plus64metadata bits.
ISCC_P2.omitted: Not full BBPO: no P3 batch optimization using unknown VLM convex-loss constants, no P4 sensing/position optimization, no optimal-round search. Named ISCC-P2, not BBPO.

AFL_OTA.preserved: Alg.1 cached gradients from last received model, all currently ready devices selected, equal-client average Eq.(8)-(10), mean/variance normalization and complex packing Eq.(11)-(16), computation overlaps communication; selected devices receive global model and start next local gradient.
AFL_OTA.changed: Existing UAVs act as clients and nominal site head as server. All-ready selection and unbiased channel inversion with analytic coherent repetition replace Alg.2 joint trajectory/device/transceiver optimizer. No invented fixed staleness delay or restricted participation quota; actual modeled compute availability determines selection. All-peer broadcast circuit accounting is kept for consistency.
AFL_OTA.omitted: Not reproduction of paper joint optimizer or its convergence guarantee. No tuned staleness bound. Error-free mean/variance metadata assumption from paper retained, with zero modeled overhead; listed limitation.

common_FU.rule: Per request cycle: descend positive image-text cosine, then retained symmetric contrastive CE from updated local model; communicate net two-step delta. Same common SGD cosine LR, retain batch16 and native captions. No clean proxy/request teacher/adaptive controller/Proposed guard.
common_FU.adaptation: Paper baselines are FL-only; GAFT extension is ours and shared across both. Two optimizer substeps per FU cycle, both charged. Not original full-model AdamW implementation.
common_FU.cache_safety: On any new deletion arrival, discard all cached FL updates and drain uninterruptible computations. Every FU uses current model, broadcasts to all, and invalidates stale caches. Never reapply a pre-deletion cache.

fairness: Same feature cache, warm20, requests,200FL,45requests and prescribed FU cycles, data partitions, route, channels, compute/propulsion constants. ISCC/AFL equal-device weighting follows papers; Proposed sample weighting retained. All outcomes kept, single development seed. Learned objectives differ, so not isolated communication comparison. Prior clean proxy gives Proposed additional planned-cohort knowledge; disclose.
limits: Fixed32-bit payload; Pmax hard. For paper protocols, network energy/update-energy/round-deadline are reported QoS limits, not grounds to erase a completed workload. Record all exceedances. User previously authorized continuing beyond caps. No physical power relaxation. No hardware-calibrated resource-solver time.
accounting: Active FL/FU communication+executed compute+hover, excluding travel/collection/preflight. FL cached jobs billed when created, even if discarded. Pipeline critical path uses actual ready times. Common9TX/1RX uplink circuit accounting and9-peer broadcasts. Shared frozen-encoder cache; adapter-only in-mission costs, not full VLM training.
publication: Code, charts, plot arrays and aggregate summaries only. Raw samples/checkpoints/logs local.
